entries.title: Autologous transplantation of cryopreserved ovary induces the generation of antiovary antibodies in sheep

protocolSteps.summary: Ovarian cortex fragments and whole sheep ovaries were cryopreserved in a controlled-rate freezer.
Specimens were stored in liquid nitrogen for 7 days.
Specimens were thawed before autologous transplantation and histological evaluation.

entries.notes: Sheep ovary transplantation study using a controlled-rate freezer and thawing after liquid nitrogen storage.

entries.title: Clinical grade vitriﬁcation of human ovarian tissue: an ultrastructural analysis of follicles and stroma in vitriﬁed tissue

protocolSteps.summary: Human ovarian tissue was vitrified in cryotubes using dimethyl sulphoxide, 1,2-propanediol, ethylene glycol and polyvinylpyrrolidone in a closed system.
Warmed vitrified tissue was compared against non-vitrified tissue by light and electron microscopic morphology.
Follicle and stroma ultrastructure was well preserved in the closed-system vitrified tissue.

outcomeMentions.summary: The ultrastructure of follicles within vitrified human ovarian tissue was well preserved in the closed cryotube system.

entries.notes: Human ovarian tissue vitrification study using a closed cryotube system with morphology-focused ultrastructural readouts.
